race.comment: LOCKYER (5) is in career-best touch, scoring stylishly here in his last two. Faces an identical set-up and only needs to hold his form to be right there again. Wider draw the only knock. JUST PRECIOUS (11) is the obvious danger, unbeaten in two runs this campaign and coming off a BM85 win at Eagle Farm where she beat the airborne Gram after jumping awkwardly. FABULANTES (4) boasts black type form and should be hitting his straps third-up over a favoured track and trip. Certainly not forgetting about him. METAPHORICALLY (10) has put two on the bounce with strong on-pace runs. Expect Roper to be burning across from out there and give them something to catch. TEN DEEP (12) was only fair when resuming but is sure to have come on from that as she stretches to a preferred trip. Draws the A1 and is another that's right in the mix.
